title: Determinism tests and back-testing against history

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: determinism.py ran the tie scenario, its rows read in set order, in five processes with hash seeds 1 to 5. What did it print?

options.text: 2 different outputs: three runs funded B, two funded A
options.says: Right: two digests matched the id-order run, which funds A, and three did not.

options.text: Same bytes five times, since each seed was fixed in advance
5 different outputs, one for each hash seed it was given
2 different outputs: four runs funded A, one funded B
options.says: Two of the five funded A, as the golden record says; three funded B.

origin.section: A Determinism Test Runs Fresh Processes and Compares Bytes

questions.stem: A team's determinism test has passed on every commit for a year. What should their suite also contain?

options.text: Nothing more, since a year of passes shows that every run repeats
options.says: A test that has never failed may be unable to fail; only a known-bad case shows it can.

options.text: A stored digest per scenario, so one test also catches moved answers
options.says: Moved answers are the golden test's job; mixing the two makes every failure ambiguous.

options.text: A case known to differ between runs, asserted to make the test fail
options.says: Right: the set-order tie case gives 2 different outputs, and the suite asserts that it does.

options.text: One fixed PYTHONHASHSEED for every child, so no run can ever differ
options.says: Each child gets its own seed on purpose, so that order bugs show instead of hiding.

origin.section: A Determinism Test Must Be Able to Fail

questions.stem: backtest.py replayed the 2024 cycle through today's model. What did it print about the plan that cycle approved?

options.text: It broke 0 of today's rules; today's NPV was 3,586 lower
options.says: It broke 2 of today's rules, and today's NPV was higher.

options.text: It broke 2 of today's rules; today's NPV was 3,586 lower
options.says: Today's NPV, 28,196, was higher than the approved 24,610.

options.text: It broke 0 of today's rules; today's NPV was 3,586 higher
options.says: It broke 2 of today's rules, overspending in 2027 first.

options.text: It broke 2 of today's rules; today's NPV was 3,586 higher
options.says: Right: 28,196 against 24,610, and two budget rows broken.

origin.section: Read Every Difference as a Question, Not a Verdict
